sections.name: Room identification
sections.capture_instructions: Film the room number or name plate, then a wide establishing shot from the doorway.

sections.name: Layout walkthrough
sections.capture_instructions: Walk the perimeter once clockwise at a steady pace. Narrate major zones (storage, work, egress).

sections.name: Conditions and hazards
sections.capture_instructions: Zoom in on any visible damage, spills, blocked exits, or missing signage. If none, state 'no issues observed' on camera.
